---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Zheyre Tolliver"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015)

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "mediumseagreen", "FALSE" = "tomato"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Improved", "FALSE" = "Declined"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in District Reading Scores, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = paste(
      format(nrow(score_change), big.mark = ","),
      "districts with scores in both years"
    ),
    x = "Change in reading score (grade levels)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    stateabb = reorder(stateabb, rla_2023),
    direction = if_else(rla_change >= 0, "Improved", "Declined")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = stateabb)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60", size = 1.5) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = stateabb, color = direction),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Declined" = "darkorange2", "Improved" = "cadetblue4"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Each arrow runs from a state's 2015 score to its 2023 score, in grade levels",
    x = "Reading score (0 = U.S. average)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
